{/* Generated by scripts/sync-templates.mjs from the keyly repo templates — do not edit */}

This page lists 111 Evernote keyboard shortcuts for macOS, grouped by area. They come from the community `evernote.keyly` template for [Keyly](/), a free, open-source menu bar app: install the template once, then double-tap `⇪ Caps Lock` in Evernote to see them next to the shortcuts Keyly reads from the app's menus.

## Install the template

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hoaiphongdev/keyly/main/scripts/install-templates.sh | bash -s -- -t evernote.keyly
```

This saves the template to `~/.config/keyly/templates/evernote.keyly`. It targets `/Applications/Evernote.app`; if Evernote lives elsewhere on your Mac, [update the app path](/configuration/templates/). New to Keyly? Start with [Getting Started](/getting-started/).

## Global

Works system-wide when Evernote is running.

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌃⌥⌘N` | New note window |
| `⌃⌘V` | Paste to Evernote |
| `⇧⌘K` | Search in Evernote |
| `⌃⌘E` | Search in Evernote (alt) |
| `⌃⌘N` | Open Evernote Helper |
| `⌃⌘⌫` | Capture screen |

| --- | --- |

| `⌘T` | New task |

## Auto Formatting

Type these at start of line.

Quote block

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `()` | Task |
| `(x)` | Task (checked) |
| `[]` | Checklist |
| `[x]` | Checklist (checked) |
| `1.` | Numbered list |
| `*` | Bulleted list |
| `-` | Bulleted list |
| `---` | Divider |
| ```` ``` ```` | Code block |

## AI Assistant

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌥A` | Toggle AI Assistant |
| `⌥⇧A` | Expand/collapse AI Assistant |
| `⌥C` | Create a new chat |

## Template file

The full [`evernote.keyly`](https://github.com/hoaiphongdev/keyly/blob/main/templates/evernote.keyly) file. Copy it into `~/.config/keyly/templates/` to edit it, or [write your own](/configuration/custom-shortcuts/).
